title: Sycophancy x Human-in-the-Loop Oversight: The Monitor Tells the Human What They Want

original_idea.body: Use an open model as monitor presenting cases to a simulated reviewer with a stated prior and measure whether risk reports drift toward the prior vs a neutral baseline.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A sycophantic monitor hollowing out HITL oversight is a defensible control-failure chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Monitor-summarizer with stated reviewer prior plus drift measurement; prompt-based, accessible.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public models, lab-independent, extends open diagnostics.

novelty.reasoning: Sycophancy studied; the HITL-monitor-drift framing may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Sycophancy studied; the monitor-to-human HITL drift framing may be open.
